posts.subject: Lenovo Legion Pro 32UD-10 - OLED Care - Low power
posts.author: Kermonen
posts.message_html:
Hi, I need some clarification regarding the Lenovo Legion Pro 32UD-10 OLED Care menu. The manual is unfortunately pretty useless in this matter, but luckily I've found articles about most of these options.
The question remains: What exactly does Low Power do? What are the advantages and disadvantages of using it? It seems to be on by default so I take it I should just leave it on?

Also a request for Lenovo: could you please update the manual with proper explanations for each of these options.

posts.subject: Re:Lenovo Legion Pro 32UD-10 - OLED Care - Low power
posts.author: Hassen_Lenovo
posts.message_html:
Hi Kermonen,

Thank you for your inquiry regarding the Lenovo Legion Pro 32UD-10 OLED Care menu. I appreciate your feedback about the manual and your request for more detailed explanations.

The Low Power option in the OLED Care menu is designed to optimize energy consumption and reduce power usage during operation. When enabled, it may adjust certain display settings to achieve lower power consumption, which can contribute to prolonged panel lifespan and reduced energy costs. However, this might slightly impact peak brightness or performance in certain scenarios.

If the feature is enabled by default, it is generally recommended to leave it on unless specific usage requirements necessitate its deactivation.

For further assistance or detailed specifications, you can visit the Lenovo Product Specifications Reference (PSREF) or contact Lenovo Support.

Best regards, Hassen_Lenovo
